sum: General Updates - Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ),…
detail: General Updates - Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ), regarding an agreement to acquire 100% stake in Evos B.V.
